detailMarkdown:
# HeyClaude Content Submission Factory

Prepare complete, source-backed HeyClaude content submissions for agents, MCP servers, tools, skills, rules, commands, hooks, guides, collections, and statuslines.

## Trust
- Source: source-backed
- Package: maintainer-built/verified package
- Review: unclaimed

## Safety notes
- The install command downloads a HeyClaude-hosted skill archive and unzips it into the current working directory.
- Review generated submission drafts before opening a PR; the skill does not publish content by itself.

## Privacy notes
- Drafting may include public source URLs, brand metadata, and resource descriptions.
- Do not include credentials, private repository details, customer data, or unpublished material in submission drafts.

## Install
```bash
curl -L https://heyclau.de/downloads/skills/heyclaude-content-submission-factory.zip -o heyclaude-content-submission-factory.zip && unzip -o heyclaude-content-submission-factory.zip -d ./heyclaude-content-submission-factory
```

## Usage
Use this skill when preparing a new HeyClaude content submission or improving an existing registry entry.
